thread:
Jamie: Quick flag — Meridian Health signed up 12 preview seats; telemetry shows only 3 active users this sprint. Renewal convo ~6 weeks after preview ends. Need a fast activation sprint.
Rohan: Noted. Which personas are mostly idle?
Jamie: Idle: 4 PMs, 3 analysts, 2 infra. Active: 2 backend engs, 1 frontend.
Elena: Propose a 3x touch plan: (1) 20s pulse to capture blockers + preferred session, (2) 45m 'mini-hack' focused on a single success KPI, (3) optional 1:1 dev pairing for integrators.
Mark: Love the mini-hack framing — teams respond to a concrete outcome. Suggest hack goal: "ship a monitored embed that returns <5% error for 95th percentile latency" (adjust language as needed).
Jamie: Risk = medium-high. If we don't hit +5 active users within 7 days after the mini-hack, escalate to AE and offer a scoped engineering sprint.
Rohan: I'll send the pulse with a role dropdown and a required "what's your blocker" one-liner. Keep it <20s.
Elena: I'll build the mini-hack agenda + starter repo: agenda = 1) 5m goals, 2) 15m demo + sample prompts, 3) 20m hands-on (pairing stations), 4) 5m next steps & success criteria. Repo will include 2 ready-to-run snippets.
cs-bot: Sandbox provisioned: meridian-beta-sandbox (ttl 11d). Credentials sent to meridian-beta@meridian.health.
Jamie: Outreach copy for buyer (copy/edit):
```
Hi — quick check: we noticed some teammates haven't had a chance to try the preview. We're running a 45m mini-hack to deliver a concrete outcome (quick embed + monitoring). Would your team join? Pick a slot: <cal.link/meridian-mini-hack>
```
Mark: Also add a "starter PR" option: we can open a tiny PR on their repo with the integration snippet if they grant access. Engineers like to see merged code.
Rohan: Owners: Rohan — pulse + buyer outreach (today). Elena — mini-hack repo + deck (EOD). Jamie — playbook updates + escalation trigger. Mark — starter PR template + instrumentation guide.
Elena: Draft mini-hack checklist: 1) confirm data ingest path, 2) share sample payload, 3) run quick smoke test, 4) pair on fail cases. Will post in #cs-hacklab.
Jamie: Playbook template to paste after session:
```
Outcome: attended / no-show / follow-up scheduled
Active seats after intervention: (n)
Hack goal agreed: (short description)
Top blockers surfaced: (list)
Success metric: (e.g., +5 active users within 7 days)
Escalation: AE + scoped eng sprint if not met
Owner + due date:
```
Rohan: Pulse sent. Added optional checkbox "Grant repo access for starter PR" for faster integration.
Mark: Starter PR template uploaded to #cs-code — includes minimal retry + error logging and a small README.
Elena: Mini-hack slots proposed: Tue 1pm, Wed 10am, Thu 3pm. Jamie: buyer replied — prefers Wed 10am. Can we confirm?
Rohan: Confirmed Wed 10am, invite sent. cs-bot created event: "Meridian - Mini-hack (preview)" Wed 10:00-10:45 PT — invites to meridian-beta@meridian.health.
Elena: Will tailor the repo snippets to their ingestion format before Wed. Sharing a lightweight notebook and Postman collection in the invite.
Jamie: If after the mini-hack we don't see the metric, Plan B = 2-hour scoped engineering pairing to push a merged starter PR. AE looped in for renewal prep.
Mark: After session I'll open a follow-up issue template so their engineers can triage quick wins.
Rohan: I'll update Gainsight renewal risk if no lift in 7 days.
Elena: Reminder set — will post meeting notes and the playbook entry into the account doc immediately after.
Jamie: Thanks team — tight cadence on this. :rocket:
